Left of the ticks the exponent form, right of the ticks the value, top to bottom: 4⁸ = 65536; 4⁷ = 16384; 4⁶ = 4096; 4⁵ = 1024; 4⁴ = 256; 4³ = 64; 4² = 16; 4¹ = 4; 4⁰ = 1; 4⁻¹ = 1/4 (stacked fraction); 4⁻² = 1/16 (stacked fraction). Four curved arrows: (a) on the left, from 4⁸ down to 4⁷, labelled '÷ 4'; (b) on the right, from 4096 (tail) up to 65536 (arrowhead), labelled '× 16' (spanning the 4096 and 16384 rows); (c) on the left lower part, from 4³ down to 4¹ (arrowhead at 4¹), labelled '÷ 16'; (d) on the right lower part, from 4 (tail) up to 16 (arrowhead), labelled '× 4'. Left bracket: three horizontal lines labelled '4⁸ ÷ 4³', '4³ × 4²', '4⁷ × 4⁻²' (top, middle, bottom, on the rows of 4⁶, 4⁵, 4⁴) merge with angled elbows into one line that ends at the 4⁵ row. Right bracket: three horizontal lines labelled '65536 ÷ 64', '64 × 16', '16384 × 1/16' (the last with a stacked fraction 1/16) merge with angled elbows into one line that ends at the 1024 row. So all six expressions equal 4⁵ = 1024.
